method: Recovery-packet-guided boundary review. Eight named PDF pages and the archived Gcn boundary detail crops were visually inspected. This recovers locators, not lost continuous collation reports or complete glyph transcriptions.

observations: PDF11 is printed page1 and presents the root title; PDF215 is printed205 with terminal colophon layout. PDF217 is printed207 with a different text title.
PDF112 is printed102. The compressed chapter-boundary text and the following de nas lha dbang passage are visible. Exact compact inscription letters remain uncertified.
limitations: Boundary-based mapping does not prove every intervening exposure or folio.
Related Adzom block manifestation; not presumed an independent textual vote.

observations: PDF407 presents the root title; PDF408 has the illustrated opening and main-text incipit. The title is partly damaged; no complete exact title transcription is adopted.
PDF484 row4 carries the Chapter1 closing formula; row5 begins the de nas lha dbang sequence. The archived boundary crops confirm the transition at the same page.
PDF555 contains the terminal colophon and closing formulas.
limitations: Provider image indices cannot be inferred from the stored 25-image preview manifest.
Full composite page rendering is required; extracting only a background image can omit text.
Repeated exposures and all intervening material remain to be accounted for; this is not continuous comparison.
